title: PowerPoint on desktop: reference webpages when creating a presentation with Copilot Agent Mode
summary: Hold: the briefing calls the web search policy the only documented switch for public web content, although Microsoft also documents a user toggle and an optional-connected-experiences policy that can disable web search. The roadmap facts and the Graph operation are supported; the admin route needs its final Cloud Policy steps.

claims.where: What's changing; Scope; Risk assessment: Change & support

claims.where: What's changing; Risk assessment: Autonomy & actions; Risk assessment: Change & support
claims.claim: The release notes describe generated slides and source references and tell users to review them.
claims.quote: Review the generated slides and source references.

claims.claim: The release-notes entry for this capability does not mention Agent Mode.
claims.quote: Searched: 555896 and Agent Mode in the fetched release-notes entry; read its heading, description, Details and Try this. The entry uses Copilot in PowerPoint, not Agent Mode.

claims.where: What's changing; Risk assessment: Data exposure; Open questions
claims.claim: Microsoft has not described whether this capability uses supplied page addresses or generated Bing queries, or its page-fetching and citation mechanism.
claims.quote: Searched: PowerPoint Agent Mode reference webpages web sources default license policy switch API; PowerPoint Agent Mode web search; PowerPoint reference webpages approval citations retention policy. Opened release notes, web-search guidance and Copilot requirements; no feature-specific route stated.

claims.claim: No Microsoft Learn page describing this specific feature beyond the release notes was found.
claims.quote: Searched: PowerPoint reference webpages; PowerPoint Agent Mode web search; PowerPoint Copilot reference web sources licence default admin control. Read the release-notes entry; other results describe app prerequisites, unrelated Copilot Chat creation agents or developer APIs.

claims.where: front matter: defaultState; summary; Why it matters; rationale: impact; Open questions
claims.claim: The arrival default of this specific capability is not stated.
claims.quote: Searched: PowerPoint Agent Mode reference webpages web sources default license policy switch API; PowerPoint Copilot reference web sources licence default admin control. Read roadmap, release-notes entry, Copilot settings and requirements; none states the feature's arrival default.

claims.claim: No source says this capability changes existing behaviour without a user requesting it.
claims.quote: Searched: PowerPoint Copilot reference web sources licence default admin control. Roadmap and release-notes entry describe referencing sources when creating a presentation and asking Copilot; neither states an automatic change to existing content or behaviour.

claims.claim: The Microsoft 365 admin center route Copilot > Settings > Data access > Web search for Microsoft Copilot and Microsoft Copilot Chat leads to the web search setting link.
claims.quote: In the left navigation, expand Copilot, and then select Settings. ... Web search for Microsoft Copilot and Microsoft Copilot Chat ... Follow the link from Copilot settings to create an Allow web search in Copilot cloud policy
claims.fix: Keep the printed route, but append to its note: 'To configure the policy, in Microsoft 365 Apps admin center go to Customization > Policy Management > Create > Start with the basics > Choose the scope > Configure Settings > Allow web search in Copilot.' Cite https://learn.microsoft.com/microsoft-365-apps/admin-center/overview-cloud-policy for the Cloud Policy steps; the existing route reaches a link rather than the policy editor.

claims.claim: POST /beta/admin/configurationManagement/configurationMonitors with applyOnce can apply the desired web search configuration.
claims.quote: applies a desired-state baseline once in applyOnce mode. ... POST https://graph.microsoft.com/beta/admin/configurationManagement/configurationMonitors

claims.claim: The applyOnce mode and microsoft.copilot.allowwebsearch resource with value 0, 1 or 2 are documented for this operation.
claims.quote: These resources also support remediation and applyOnce. ... The value property is a string, not a Boolean or a number. ... Controls web search. 0 enables it ... 1 disables it in both. 2 disables it in Microsoft 365 Copilot Work mode

claims.claim: The Microsoft 365 admin center setting links to creation of the cloud policy in Microsoft 365 Apps admin center.
claims.quote: Follow the link from Copilot settings to create an Allow web search in Copilot cloud policy in the Microsoft 365 Apps admin center.

claims.where: controls[0].governs; Why it matters; Risk assessment: Security & identity
claims.claim: Allow web search in Copilot is a Cloud Policy service control for turning web search on or off for users or groups in Microsoft Copilot and Microsoft Copilot Chat.
claims.quote: This policy allows IT admins to either turn on or turn off web search for users or user groups across the tenant they manage ... This policy applies to both Microsoft Copilot and Microsoft Copilot Chat.

claims.where: controls[0].note; Why it matters; Governance controls; rationale: risk; Open questions
claims.claim: The documentation does not explicitly establish that the web search policy gates this specific webpage-referencing route.
claims.quote: Searched: Allow web search in Copilot PowerPoint; PowerPoint Agent Mode web search. Read web-search guidance, requirements, settings and release notes; general web-search reach is stated, but this route is not identified as Bing search.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Security & identity; Open questions
claims.claim: Microsoft does not explicitly say the user web-search toggle gates this specific webpage-referencing route.
claims.quote: Searched: PowerPoint Agent Mode web search; Allow web search in Copilot PowerPoint. Read web-search guidance and the release-notes entry; the user control covers supported web-search experiences, but this capability's query or direct-fetch route is not specified.

claims.where: controls[1]; Risk assessment: Security & identity; Governance controls; Open questions
claims.claim: No tenant UI switch or automation specific to referencing webpages in PowerPoint Agent Mode alone is documented.
claims.quote: Searched: PowerPoint Agent Mode reference webpages web sources default license policy switch API; Microsoft Graph PowerPoint web search policy. Read Copilot settings, Cloud Policy overview, TCM Copilot resources and remediation resources; no separate feature switch or operation appears.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Data exposure; rationale: risk
claims.claim: Copilot web search generates a short query and sends it to Bing.
claims.quote: Copilot generates a search query that it sends to the Bing search service asking for more information. ... it consists of a few words informed by the user's prompt.

claims.claim: Copilot also sends the user's client IP address to Bing with a web search request.
claims.quote: When Copilot sends a web search request to the Bing search service, it also sends the user's client IP address

claims.claim: Generated web search queries do not contain entire Microsoft 365 files.
claims.quote: The following information isn't included in the generated search query sent to the Bing search service: ... Entire Microsoft 365 files (for example, emails or documents) or files uploaded into Copilot

claims.claim: A Copilot web search query can be informed by an open Microsoft 365 document when a user prompts within an app.
claims.quote: it may also be informed by data within a Microsoft 365 document ... When a user enters a prompt into Copilot inside a Microsoft 365 application (for example, writing a prompt into Copilot in Microsoft Word while a relevant document is open).

claims.where: Risk assessment: Data exposure; Governance guidance; rationale: risk
claims.claim: The Data Protection Addendum does not apply to generated Copilot web search queries.
claims.quote: The Microsoft Products and Services Data Protection Addendum (DPA) doesn't apply to the use of generated web search queries in Microsoft Copilot, Microsoft Copilot Chat, or the Bing search service.

claims.claim: HIPAA compliance does not apply to generated web search queries.
claims.quote: Also, HIPAA compliance and the EU Data Boundary don't apply to generated search queries.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Data exposure; Governance guidance
claims.claim: The EU Data Boundary does not apply to generated web search queries.
claims.quote: Also, HIPAA compliance and the EU Data Boundary don't apply to generated search queries.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Security & identity; Governance controls
claims.claim: A user-level Web content control exists in Microsoft Copilot.
claims.quote: The Web content toggle gives users control over whether Microsoft Copilot includes real-time web content in responses and is now available to both Microsoft Copilot and Microsoft Copilot Chat users.

claims.claim: Users can turn web search off themselves when administrators allow it.
claims.quote: If the IT admin turns on web search for Microsoft Copilot users, those users still have the option to turn off web search by using the Web content toggle.

claims.claim: When administrators disable web search, the user toggle is off and dimmed and users cannot enable it.
claims.quote: If the IT admin turns off web search, the Web content toggle is turned off and appears dimmed. Users can't turn on the toggle to use web search.

claims.claim: Microsoft does not describe an approval step before this feature uses web content.
claims.quote: Searched: PowerPoint Copilot reference webpages approval citations retention policy; read the complete release-notes entry. Its Try this sequence is start a presentation, ask Copilot, then review generated slides and references; no prior approval step is described.

claims.claim: The release notes do not state how long source references remain in the presentation file.
claims.quote: Searched: PowerPoint Copilot reference webpages approval citations retention policy. Read the complete release-notes entry; it mentions reviewing source references but no retention duration. General AI prompt-retention results do not establish retention of references within a deck.

The same cited page also documents the user control and the effect of disabling additional optional connected experiences; do not claim exclusivity.

claims.fix: Replace the exclusive Cloud Policy role requirement with: 'The Copilot settings page names Office Apps admin for Cloud Policy creation; the Cloud Policy overview recommends Office Apps Administrator and also lists Security Administrator and Global Administrator as supported management roles.' claims.claim: TCM supports these Copilot settings only in tenant-level policies.

claims.quote: ensure that the target setting isn't configured in any group-level policy in that admin center. If it is, monitoring, snapshots, remediation, and applyOnce fail for that resource.

claims.claim: TCM remediation and applyOnce are available only in the global service, not national clouds.
claims.quote: Tenant Configuration Management (TCM) drift remediation and applyOnce monitors change workload configuration ... TCM is available only in the global service, not in national clouds.
